blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings went from 161 to 165, and it took 49.8% of the city’s 215 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings went from 71 to 69, and it took 13.8% of the city’s 318 sales over the period.

The monthly write-ups singled out Abbotsford East for detached houses in June, July, August (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in September (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in July, August (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, September (a buyers’ best bet).

faq.q: Which public schools are inside Abbotsford East?
faq.a: SD34 schools inside the area include Sandy Hill Elementary, Mountain Elementary, Irene Kelleher Totí:ltawtxw Elementary, Auguston Traditional Elementary, Clayburn Middle, Robert Bateman Secondary and Yale Secondary; use the SD34 School Locator with a home address to confirm the catchment school for that address. Locator runs for two sample addresses confirm the pattern: 36367 Stephen Leacock Drive returns Auguston Traditional Elementary → Clayburn Middle → Robert Bateman Secondary, and 3836 Old Clayburn Road returns Sandy Hill Elementary → Clayburn Middle → Robert Bateman Secondary (SD34 School Locator, mybaragar.com, run 2026-11-01).

faq.q: Which buses serve the east side?
faq.a: BC Transit Central Fraser Valley routes include 2 (Highstreet / McMillan), 7 (Sumas Mountain), 9 (McKee) and 15 (Auguston), plus the 66 Fraser Valley Express on Highway 1.

faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
